fact: On 7 July 2026 Abu Hujar locality began applying the electronic collection and payment system Esali (إيصالي) in its land offices and collection departments, the state Ministry of Finance having supplied the devices and trained all the collectors.
title: محلية ابوحجار تطبق نظام التحصيل والسداد الإلكتروني بهدف ضبط الإيرادات وتجويد الاداء
